en: Black-and-white postcard showing a tree-lined pond or small lake with rowboats along the shore and a few people boating on the water. In the background behind the trees stands a historic-looking building with two pointed towers. The lower margin bears printed German captions identifying the view as from Graz and naming the location as Hilmteich, along with a publisher credit from Vienna.
